$description: Soft demo: hds#505's token deltas as a tenant overlay, the spike before any change to the default. Shape (role.radius from semantic.radius.action, 20px: a full pill on the 40px default control, containers 24px), grey-fill grouping (semantic.color.surface.raised, with role.card following it) and roomier surfaces (semantic.space.surface.padding, scale.lg at rest, scale.md compact). Colour of the accent, type and control height are NOT changed: see the README's Gaps for what the tokens cannot express today. Demo exemplar only, no deployment, no legal entity.

radius.$description: Soft demo: re-anchored to the overridden semantic.radius.action. --role-radius is declared on :root, so without this line it resolves there and a [data-brand] set on any element below <html> never reaches rounded-md/lg/sm (the way brutalist-demo sets it directly).

card.$description: Soft demo: re-anchored to the overridden surface.raised, for the same reason as role.radius (--role-card is declared on :root). bg-card and the static .hds-card read it.

action.$description: Soft demo: 20px, half of the 40px default control (primitive.space.10), so Button, Input and Select md are a full pill, and sm (32px) clamps to one. Containers are action + 4 (24px) and nested chrome action - 2 (18px). hds#505 asks for pill actions AND 16-20px containers; one knob cannot give both (see Gaps).

raised.$description: Soft demo: a visible grey fill in light (neutral.100, was neutral.50) so cards and tracks group by fill with no border. Dark is already a fill (neutral.850) and is kept.

padding.$description: Soft demo: roomier surfaces, 32px at rest (scale.lg; was 24px, scale.md), 20px under [data-density="compact"] (scale.md under the compact remap), the same compact value as the default. Was semantic.space.component.padding before hds#206.
